summary: iter4 regression on LoveWorks after PWA + Trips + Essentials + Collaborators + concurrent clocks. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass against deployed REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend smoke: admin dashboard, worker dashboard, notification bell (no clipping), and Trips/Essentials nav all render without page errors. Service worker registers and activates on load; static PWA assets (manifest, sw.js, icons, apple-touch-icon, maskable icons) all return 200. SW correctly skips /api and non-GET requests so backend flows are unaffected. The console 401s seen are expected pre-login /auth/me probes; they do NOT block flows.
critical_code_review_comments: sw.js correctly filters non-GET and /api paths (server.py all API under /api). Confirms no interception of backend calls.
sw.js precaches ['/', '/manifest.json', '/icon-192.png', '/icon-512.png', '/apple-touch-icon.png']; all 200. If any listed asset ever 404s, install would silently continue due to .catch — acceptable.

Concurrent clock semantics correct: /api/time/clock-in blocks duplicate same-activity (400) but allows different concurrent activities. /api/time/clock-out with no query closes ALL active entries. /api/time/active returns list.
/api/goals supports kind='trip'; workers can create, admin can list. Trips share goals collection as documented.
/api/essentials create uses Query params (title, price, quantity, category, ...). PATCH uses JSON body EssentialUpdate. purchased toggle works and totals endpoint returns 200.
server.py is ~2722 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; splitting into routers (auth, tasks, time, goals, essentials, peers, notifications, admin) would improve maintainability. Not blocking.
No MongoDB _id leakage observed in any tested response.
test_credentials: Admin admin@clockwork.com / admin123, Worker lovetest@loveworks.com / Love123! — both verified. Ephemeral TEST_ data auto-cleaned via teardown.
seed_data_creation: All rows created by iter4 prefixed with 'TEST_' (tasks, goals, trips, essentials). Cleaned up in class teardown via DELETE endpoints. Worker clock state reset before and after concurrent-clocks test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_loveworks_iter4.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iter4.xml (~5s). Preserves credentials session across the class-scoped fixtures. If concurrent-clocks test flakes, call POST /api/time/clock-out first to reset. Goals and Trips share the same collection; filter with ?kind=trip. Worker page has inline goals-card (no separate /goals nav for workers) and tasks inline (no /tasks nav for workers) — do NOT expect nav-goals / nav-tasks testids on worker UI; admin has both nav-goals and nav-tasks. Notification bell testid is 'notification-bell' and renders as a popover (no clipping).
